question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Neice"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Niece."** (भतीजी / भांजी)

 
 
• **Example: **My **niece** loves to draw and paint.
 
 
 
• **"Niece"** refers to the daughter of one's brother or sister, or of one's brother-in-law or sister-in-law. (भतीजी / भांजी)
 
 
• **Example: **She bought a lovely birthday gift for her** niece.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dilemma **(दुविधा): A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives.

 
 
• **Example:** She faced a dilemma about whether to accept the job offer or stay in her current position.
 
 
 
• **Warranty **(गारंटी): A written guarantee, issued to the purchaser of an article by its manufacturer, promising to repair or replace it if necessary within a specified period of time.
 
 
• **Example: **The phone comes with a two-year warranty.
 
 
 
• **Committee** (समिति): A group of people appointed for a specific function by a larger group and typically consisting of members of that group.
 
 
• **Example:** The committee will meet next week to discuss the new policy.
